scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare:dev && pnpm run build:desktop && cross-env APM_ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:dist-assets && pnpm run build:desktop
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64
scripts.tauri:init: pnpm dlx @tauri-apps/cli@2 init --app-name agent-project-manager-desktop --window-title 'Agent Project Manager' --dist-dir ../frontend/dist --ci
